lines.text: God tells Israel to stop quoting the sour grapes proverb, because every soul belongs to Him and the soul who sins will die.
A righteous man who does not rob, oppress, or look to idols, and keeps God's statutes, will surely live.
A violent son of that righteous man eats at the mountain and lifts his eyes to idols, so he will not live.
The violent man's son sees his father's sins and does not copy them, so he will live while his father dies.
God says He will judge Israel as one nation together, and tells them to cast away their transgressions and repent.
